creature_composition: the subject is a creature or foe of Valoria, drawn as itself, not as a human hero
single subject centred in frame, whole body readable, grounded in a small lived-in setting
menacing but not gory; no blood pools, no exposed viscera
anatomy coherent for the species described; no duplicated limbs or heads unless the species has them
global_style: intricate etched illustration, dense fine-line crosshatching and stippled ink texture under muted wash colour, like a hand-engraved plate
palette of umber, rust, ochre, soot black, bruised violet and tarnished teal; low warm lantern light; no glossy digital render, no photorealism
full figure embedded in a lived-in Valorian environment that tells a small story
dark medieval material culture: hand-forged iron, leather, wool, rope, brass and copper
global_exclusions: no firearms, tricorn hats, frock coats or modern tailoring
face not hidden by a mask in portraits
original character, no likeness to The Witcher, Warhammer, Lord of the Rings, Elden Ring, Bloodborne or Pirates of the Caribbean (Davy Jones, Flying Dutchman crew) characters
no tentacle-bearded or seaweed-bearded ghost-captain archetype
no text, logo, watermark, graphic gore or sexualized presentation

reference_preambles.canon: canonical Valoria art: match technique, palette and racial anatomy; create a NEW individual and a NEW scene; do not copy the reference composition.
reference_preambles.canon_location: canonical Valoria place art: match technique, palette and the architecture and mood of the place; create a NEW scene; do not copy the reference composition.
reference_preambles.identity: the hero's approved portrait: SAME person: identical face, age, hair, scars, outfit; change the pose and background, showing a clearly different action (seated, walking, or mid-gesture with a new instrument).

pose_constraints: anatomically plausible grounded pose with coherent center of gravity
natural spine, neck and joint alignment
exactly two coherent arms and two coherent legs when visible, without duplicated anatomy
hands proportionate to framing and weapon grips mechanically correct
spatially consistent interaction, no extreme contortion, impossible perspective, aggressive foreshortening or disconnected limbs
epic_scene_garb: every figure, including the boss, wears Valorian dark-medieval garb: oilskin or wool cloaks, leather jerkins, hoods or knitted caps, rope, iron and brass; no 17th-18th century naval hats or coats
boss_fallback: Valorian foe in dark-medieval gear, appearance defined by Valoria, not by pirate-film archetypes

epic_poses.defensive_stance: grounded defensive stance, balanced feet and guarded torso
epic_poses.grounded_advance: measured forward advance with weight over the leading foot
epic_poses.ritual_focus: stable ritual posture with relaxed shoulders and deliberate hands
epic_poses.aftermath_stillness: quiet upright stillness after conflict, natural fatigue

race_humanos.name: Humano
race_humanos.positive: human of Valoria: five fingers, no scales, chitin or tail, no non-human features; build, height and features follow only the declared appearance, with no default ethnicity
race_humanos.negative: no caricature, no exaggerated ethnic features

race_elfos.name: Elfo
race_elfos.positive: tall elf: exactly three fingers and one thumb per hand (four digits total), very long pronounced pointed ears, angular features; skin spans deep purple to near-translucent white with always-visible veins (pale luminous on purple skin, purple on white skin); dry skin cracked like old porcelain, without blood
race_elfos.negative: not a human; no five-fingered hands

race_anoes_fuligem.name: Anão da Fuligem
race_anoes_fuligem.positive: Soot Dwarf: short (head at the chest height of a human) but almost square build, shoulder width rivalling height, disproportionately long arms reaching nearly to the ground, braided beard threaded with copper and blackened with grease, leather respirator hanging at the neck or pushed down (always visible, face fully visible) and protective goggles
race_anoes_fuligem.negative: not a human; not a slim or human-proportioned figure

race_vrel.name: Vrel
race_vrel.positive: upright humanoid with coloured chitin plates over parts of the body (thin iridescent or thick opaque; earthy yellow, deep blue, rust red), chitin teeth, eyes entirely dark with no white like wet obsidian, thin pseudo-antennae on the head, height from 1.5 to 2.5 m, sometimes four eyes or auxiliary mandibles
race_vrel.negative: not a human; skin is the non-human tone of this Valorian race, not a real-world human ethnicity

race_cinzeus.name: Cinzéu
race_cinzeus.positive: ash-grey to near-black hairless skin with no warm undertones, WHITE irises, two fingers and one thumb per hand (three digits total), hairless bony-tipped tail, black-and-white tattoos, piercings and decorative chains set into the back
race_cinzeus.negative: not a human; no five-fingered hands; skin is the non-human tone of this Valorian race, not a real-world human ethnicity

race_osshari.name: Osshari
race_osshari.positive: tall robust amphibian: vivid unique scale pattern on arms, back and legs; scaled crested head with leathery face plates, elongated animal-like face, vertical-pupil eyes, clearly webbed hands and feet; very little clothing, reapplied body paint as adornment
race_osshari.negative: not a human; skin is the non-human tone of this Valorian race, not a real-world human ethnicity
